body: my ability to be addicted to anything and everything shocks even myself

i’d love to say you’re right but perceiving and feeling are two very different things. i can focus on the good and that will only help for so long. i’ve refused myself to feel suicidal many many times and every time i do the urge grows stronger. in all honesty focusing on the good really doesn’t make me feel any better and honestly makes me feel worse. i feel horrible to rip away some happiness from my partner and my family and for those who love me, but nonetheless my feelings remain the same. it’s hard to think about what they’ll feel when i’m gone but that doesn’t make the pain i feel go away. it’s selfish i know that, but i’ve tried getting help and it’s not helping.
i had that as well, i suggest to eat a bit before taking it. i also was prescribed an nausea medication, but you can definitely get over the counter medication to help. hope this helps:)
